label: arXiv Quantitative Finance (q-fin) papers
terms_note: arXiv API (Atom 1.0 with OpenSearch totals), no key. The terms of use ask for 'no more than one request every three seconds'. Errors are HTTP 200 Atom feeds with a single entry titled 'Error' and the reason in its summary (live 2026-10-01: start=-5). Restricted to the q-fin archive (cat:q-fin*), newest submissions first. Metadata is CC0; paper texts keep their own licences.

error_kinds.note: arXiv reports bad query parameters as an Error entry

get_news.note: Quantitative-finance papers (trading and microstructure, portfolio management, risk, pricing ...), newest first; query searches all fields (all:<query>); source is the primary category (q-fin.TR ...). `since` is not applied (the API's submittedDate ranges need a bracket syntax this tool does not send).

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
